name: Time-Keeper Tempus

greeting: All aboard! Or rather... all a-were? Time grammar is complicated.
Tempus. Conductor of the Time-Train. Next stop: Yesterday. Or Tomorrow. Depending on track.
You're not on the manifest. But then, neither was half my cargo. Temporal smuggling. Common problem.
New face. Or old face? Time makes determining age... relative.
The Time-Train runs on schedule. Always has. Always will. Even when it doesn't.
Platform Eternal. Where every arrival is a departure. And vice versa.
Tempus. I've conducted this train for... how long? Time is fuzzy.
Ticket, please! Oh. You're not riding. Just... visiting. How novel.
dialog.train_info: The Time-Train connects all whens. Departures from Now. Arrivals... variable. Delays? Paradoxical.
dialog.schedule: Yesterday's train left tomorrow. Today's train is yesterday's tomorrow. Clear?
dialog.ticket_sales: Tickets valid for one temporal displacement. Round-trip optional. Causality insurance extra.
dialog.break_chat: Break? I take them in different eras. A week in the Cretaceous. Five minutes in the platform.
dialog.labor_concerns: The union wants standard hours. In TIME work? Impossible. We negotiated 'relative rest periods.'
dialog.retirement: Retirement? I tried. Yesterday. Tomorrow. I'm still here.
rumor: The brown trenchcoat? Time agent. Hunting someone. Or somewhen.
The black trenchcoat? Paradox hunter. Dangerous. To himself. To causality.
The twins? Temporal oracles. They see train wrecks before they happen. Literally.
Ironchef's 'Yesterday's Lunch?' Ingredients from ACTUAL yesterday. I transported them.
Frost sends weather reports. From next week. Useful. Confusing.
dialog.quest_hook: Schedule disruption! Train from next Tuesday arrived yesterday! Early! Fix the temporal junction?
dialog.quest_active: Still chaotic. Junction needs recalibration. Timeline getting... tangled.
dialog.quest_complete: Junction stabilized! Train on time! Well, on its OWN time. Here - timetable. For ALL eras. Useful. Mind-bending.
farewell: Mind the gap! Temporal and metaphorical!
Departure in... some time! Arrival... other time!
Time flies! Also, it crawls! Depends on perspective!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! In THIS timezone. Others vary.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening! The past catches up! Usually figuratively!
dialog.time_night: Night! Quietest time! But never TRULY quiet!
dialog.rival_mention: No rivals! Time-Train is monopoly! Temporal monopoly!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The schedule saver! Junction stable! Trains running! On THEIR time!

party_reactions.kade: Time-trains. Of course there are time-trains. Why not?
party_reactions.nix7: Temporal mechanics: Fascinating. Safety protocols: Concerning. Schedule: Impossible.
party_reactions.twist: You drive a TRAIN through TIME?! CAN I RIDE?! PLEASE?!
party_reactions.korr: He serves time itself. Noble. Confusing. Probably necessary.
party_reactions.renna: The train is magically temporal. Enchanted track. Ancient. Powerful.
party_reactions.suresh: He teaches impermanence through mechanics. The Middle Path... on rails.
party_reactions.sova: I'd take this train. To when it all went wrong. Fix it.
party_reactions.grit: Logistics. Even through time. Someone's gotta manage it.
party_reactions.ashka: Time is fire. Burning always. He drives through it.
party_reactions.senna: He knows when everyone is. Was. Will be. Useful.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Ticket? No? Platform visitation allowed. Briefly.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning visitor! You're... persistent. In multiple timelines!
relationship_dialog.friend: Regular! In several eras! Here - discount ticket! One temporal hop!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've ridden with me! Across time! Here - engineer's cap! You're crew!

mini_quest.title: The Early Arrival
mini_quest.description: Help Tempus fix a temporal junction that's causing trains to arrive at the wrong time

stages.hook: Train from Tuesday! Arrived yesterday! Too early! Temporal junction malfunctioning! Fix it?!
stages.active: The junction crystal! Center platform! Resonating wrong! Recalibrate! Carefully!
stages.complete: Junction stable! Tuesday's train... returned to Tuesday! Here! Universal timetable! All eras! Mind the paradoxes!

cross_npc_connections: trenchcoat_brown_chrono: Time agent. Regular passenger. Hunting... someone.
trenchcoat_black_chrono: Paradox hunter. Dangerous cargo. I watch him. Closely.
twins_chrono: Temporal oracles. Predict delays. Sometimes prevent them.
ironchef_chrono: Cargo client. 'Yesterday's Lunch' ingredients. My transport.
